dialect.detail: isCobol (isCOBOL Evolve by Veryant) – GUI screen designer generated code; uses iscobol-specific directives, handle OF WINDOW/FONT, MODIFY/INQUIRE screen verbs, w$font call, and isgui.def/iscobol.def copybooks

purpose.domain_detail: Monochrome pixel-art / run-length encoding game or demo using an isCobol GUI grid
purpose.summary: A GUI application that displays a 10x10 grid (MonoChrome Picture) allowing the user to toggle cells black/white by double-clicking, then encode the grid state as a run-length encoded string or decode such a string back into the grid. Includes Reset, enCode, and deCode buttons.

notable_features: isCobol GUI screen section with HANDLE OF WINDOW and HANDLE OF FONT
MODIFY/INQUIRE verbs for GUI grid manipulation
Run-length encoding algorithm implemented in COBOL
Git merge conflict markers present in source (<<<<<<< HEAD / >>>>>>> branch)
Multiple iscobol-specific COPY books (isgui.def, iscobol.def, iscrt.def, isfonts.def, isresize.def, ismsg.def, isopensave.def)
Event-driven GUI loop with MSG-GD-DBLCLICK event handling
verdict.notes: File contains unresolved Git merge conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD / >>>>>>> branch) differing only in the AUTHOR line. The code was auto-generated by the isCobol screen designer from MonoChrome.isp and then manually extended. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the truncated portion appears to be the tail of DBL-CLICKED-RTN and RESET-RTN paragraphs.
